description: List metadata-only public-records acquisition evidence lanes. Returns durable cloud evidence, public-route checks, records-law gate posture, holdbacks, and next safe action without exposing raw payloads or send-ready request copy.

current_status.description: Optional acquisition status filter such as 'public_r2_partial_downstream_screen_complete'.

geography.description: Optional geography token filter such as 'US-FL-Orange' or 'US-AZ-Maricopa'.

lane_id.description: Optional exact acquisition lane identifier such as 'georgia_permit_public_routes'.

records_law_gate.description: Optional request-gate posture such as 'closed_no_send_ready_candidate' or 'draft_only_no_live_request'.

source_family.description: Optional source-family filter such as 'utility_energy_infrastructure' or 'assessor_tax'.

name: list_public_records_acquisition

result.description: Raw JSON response body returned by the Homecastr API.
